paths.name: Path of Alchemy
paths.description: A mastery path focused on immediate, direct effects

ability.name: Chaotic Force
ability.description: The Critical chance on Tzeentch's Cry, Scourge and Flash of Chaos is raised by 15%.

ability.name: Ritual of Innervation
ability.note:
Requires an active Ritual Nexus
You may only have 1 Ritual active
ability.description: You infuse your Ritual Nexus with the Ritual of Innervation. Group members within 50 feet of your Nexus gain 50 Action Points and the Action Point cost of their abilities is reduced by 25% for 10 seconds if they remain within 50 feet of the Nexus.

ability.name: Burst of Chaos
ability.description: Whenever your target is below 50% health, Tzeentch's Cry's damage is increased by 75%.

ability.name: Storm of Ravens
ability.description: You call forth a flock of ravens to confound your foe, dealing 1848 Corporeal damage over 6 seconds  and snaring them by 40%. This effect will end if you break your concentration, or run out of action points.

ability.name: Changer's Touch
ability.description: Critical direct damage hits place a debuff on your target that reduces all incoming healing by 35% for 7 seconds.

ability.name: Aethyric Shock
ability.description: Overwhelms your opponent with power, inflicting 396 Corporeal damage and Staggers the target for up to 6 seconds, preventing all actions unless they're damaged.

ability.name: Tzeentch’s Shielding
ability.description: All group mates within 100 feet are granted 250 Action Points, and for 20 seconds, everyone will absorb up to 5400 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Scourge
coreAbilities.description: Power lashes out and inflicts 477 Corporeal damage.

coreAbilities.name: Flash of Chaos
coreAbilities.description: A burst of chaos that restores 381 health to an ally.

coreAbilities.name: Mark of Daemonic Fury
coreAbilities.description:
Increases a groupmember's Strength, Ballistic Skill, and Intelligence by 100.  The bearer of this Mark may also activate it like an ability to deal an additional 187 Corporeal damage on their next 5 attacks within 10 seconds. This effect cannot trigger more than once per second.
You may only give a player one Mark, but players may bear multiple Marks of different types at the same time.

coreAbilities.name: Tzeentch's Cry
coreAbilities.description: A quick bolt of power that deals 321 Corporeal damage.

coreAbilities.name: Elixir Of Dark Blessings
coreAbilities.description:
Heals your target for 1125 health.
This is a fragile spell, and will sometimes be set back by a small amount if you are damaged while casting it.

coreAbilities.name: Boon of Tzeentch
coreAbilities.description: Drains 376 health from your target, funneling 150% of the amount drained into your defensive target.

paths.name: Path of Witchcraft
paths.description: A mastery path focused on longer-duration effects

ability.name: Lashing Waves
ability.description: Tzeentch's Lash will now strike all opponents within 20 feet of your initial target.

ability.name: Ritual of Superiority
ability.note:
Requires an active Ritual Nexus
You may only have 1 Ritual active
ability.description: You infuse your Ritual Nexus with the Ritual of Superiority. All allies within 25 feet of the Ritual Nexus receive a shield that wil absorb up to 825 damage for up to 10 seconds. Then all group members within 50 feet of the Nexus gain a shield every 2.5 seconds, absorbing up to 375 damage for up to 10 seconds.

ability.name: Tzeentch's Refreshment
ability.description: Direct heals have a 25% chance to grant your target 50 AP, but will not restore AP to yourself.

ability.name: Mirror of Madness
ability.description: You deal 1165 Corporeal damage to your target over 15 seconds and your defensive target is healed for 150% of the damage done.

ability.name: Transference
ability.description: While under the effects of your Harbinger of Doom; you gain 10% disrupt strikethrough and each time you deal direct damage, your defensive target is healed for 50% of the damage dealt.

ability.name: Changer's Echo
ability.description: You Hex your target with a warping gift from the Changer. After 5 seconds, raw Chaos erupts within them, dealing 507 Corporeal damage. The damage is increased by 25% if your target is affected by Warp Reality.

ability.name: Tzeentch's Scream
ability.description: All groupmates within 100 feet are healed for 3600 health over 15 seconds and regain 25 Action Points every second for 15 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Warp Reality
coreAbilities.description: Inflicts 985 Corporeal damage over 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Veil of Chaos
coreAbilities.description: For the next 10 seconds, your target will absorb up to 825 damage. When the effect fades they will regain 246 health.

coreAbilities.name: Dark Medicine
coreAbilities.description: Restores 309 health to an ally, and then restores an additional 370 health over 5 seconds. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

coreAbilities.name: Mark of the Spell Destroyer
coreAbilities.description:
Increases a groupmember's Initiative and Willpower by 100.  The bearer of this Mark may activate it like an ability to cleanse one Curse, one Hex and one Ailment from themselves.
You may only give a player one Mark, but players may bear multiple Marks of different types at the same time.

coreAbilities.name: Tzeentch's Lash
coreAbilities.description: Inflicts 525 Corporeal damage over 4 seconds and silences the target, preventing them from using any magic.

paths.name: Path of Dark Rites
paths.description: A mastery path focused on wide-area effects

ability.name: Sweeping Disgorgement
ability.description: Demon Spittle grows ever more corrosive and now also reduces Armor by 660 and Corporeal resistance by 240.

ability.name: Ritual of Lunacy
ability.note:
Requires an active Ritual Nexus
You may only have 1 Ritual active
ability.description: You infuse your Ritual Nexus with the Ritual of Lunacy. For the next 10 seconds, group members within 50 feet of your Nexus have their chance to critically hit increased by 10% and their next attack within 10 seconds will deal an additional 150 Corporeal damage.

ability.name: Manipulation
ability.description: Any time you directly heal someone, there is a  25% chance your offensive target will take corporeal damage equal to 25% of the healed value.

ability.name: Chaotic Agitation
ability.description: You channel dark forces into your target and all targets within 25 feet of them, dealing 307 Corporeal damage every 2 seconds for up to 6 seconds. This damage is increased by 25% when hitting targets within 50 feet of your Ritual Nexus.

ability.name: Tzeentch's Grip
ability.description: Direct heals you cast have a 25% chance to create a shield on your target that can absorb up to 712 damage over 10 seconds.

ability.name: Wind of Insanity
ability.description: You call forth ferocious winds for up to 6 seconds, knocking back players within 25 feet of you a short distance without granting them immunity, and will knock down monsters for 3 seconds. Targets cannot be knocked back more than once every 1.5 seconds. If under Harbinger of Change, all group members within 50ft will be healed for 169 health per second. If under Harbinger of Doom, you will inflict 234 Corporeal damage per second to all enemies affected by the winds.

ability.name: Windblock
ability.description: Inflicts 1200 damage to all targets within 25 feet of you, making heals 50% less effective on them for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Rite of Agony
coreAbilities.description: Pains washes over enemies within 25 feet of you, inflicting 226 Corporeal damage.

coreAbilities.name: Mark of the Vortex
coreAbilities.description:
Increases all your groupmember's resistances by 240.  The bearer of this Mark may activate it to absorb up to 1387 damage from ranged and magic attacks for 10 seconds. 
You may only give a player one Mark, but players may bear multiple Marks of different types at the same time.

coreAbilities.name: Leaping Alteration
coreAbilities.description: A bolt of healing energy which instantly leaps to allies within 30 feet of the last affected, restoring 783 health over 9 seconds. This effect will only pass through each target once, and will affect up to 6 allies.

coreAbilities.name: Dust of Pandemonium
coreAbilities.description: All group members within 100 feet of you are healed for 898.

coreAbilities.name: Demon Spittle
coreAbilities.description: Spews a vile mixture over everything 40 feet in front of you, dealing 636 Corporeal damage over 9 seconds to all opponents.

coreAbilities.name: Reinforce War Engine
coreAbilities.description: You heal the ram for 750 health over the next 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Cleanse War Engine
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted cleanse. Removes two siege specific debuffs from a friendly siege engine.

coreAbilities.name: Shield the Skies
coreAbilities.description: Ranged siege engines will deal 90% of the normal damage to you. You will also protect two other group mates within 40 feet. Only one effect of this type may be on a player at a time.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Harbinger of Doom
coreAbilities.description:
When this ability is toggled on, you are the Harbinger of Doom, converting your Healing Power, Willpower, and Healing Critical Chance bonuses from items into Magic Power, Intelligence, and Magic Critical Chance.

When this ability is toggled off, you are the Harbinger of Change, converting your Magic Power, Intelligence, and Magic Critical Chance bonuses from items into Healing Power, Willpower, and Healing Critical Chance.

coreAbilities.name: Tzeentch Shall Remake You
coreAbilities.description: Tzeentch dislikes losing a pawn so soon. Your target is resurrected with 20% health so that Tzeentch may continue his game.

coreAbilities.name: Tzeentch's Cordial
coreAbilities.description: Heals your target for 1520 over 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Chaotic Blur
coreAbilities.description: Detaunts targets attack power to 50% for 15 seconds. You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken. If you attack anyone that you have Detaunted, the effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Divine Favor
coreAbilities.description: A strong heal that will restore 1800 health to your target.

coreAbilities.name: Warped Flesh
coreAbilities.description:
Any time you are attacked, there is a 25% chance that you will absorb up to 375 damage.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Glimpse of Chaos
coreAbilities.note: Target must be Cursed or Hexed
coreAbilities.description: You call upon the power of chaos, removing one Curse or Hex from your defensive target.

coreAbilities.name: Rampaging Siphon
coreAbilities.description: Deals 600 damage to all enemies within 25 feet, and heals group members within 100 feet for the full amount of the damage dealt.

coreAbilities.name: Divine Fury
coreAbilities.description:
You deal 25% more damage, but your healing output is reduced by 20%.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Endless Gifts
coreAbilities.description: Cooldown on Glimpse of Chaos is reduced by 5s and the cost increased by 15 Action Points.

coreAbilities.name: Discipline
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Willpower by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Steal Life
coreAbilities.description: Your target suffers 1200 damage over 9 seconds, and you are healed for half of the damage dealt.

coreAbilities.name: Tzeentch's Warding
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Elemental resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Ritual Nexus
coreAbilities.description: You cast a Ritual Nexus on the ground that infuses your group, restoring 152 health every 3 seconds to those within 50 feet of the Ritual Nexus. To maintain your Ritual Nexus, you have to remain within 150 feet and your Action Point regeneration is reduced by 5.

coreAbilities.name: Cancel Ritual Nexus
coreAbilities.description: Cancel your current Ritual Nexus.

coreAbilities.name: Prolonged Suffering
coreAbilities.description: Each time Warp Reality or Demon Spittle damages an enemy, there is a 33% chance that the victim will suffer an additional 209 Corporeal damage.

coreAbilities.name: Waves of Chaos
coreAbilities.description: Your Ritual Nexus no longer heals group members, instead it spreads Waves of Chaos, dealing 179 Corporeal damage every 3 seconds to all enemies with 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Focused Mind
coreAbilities.description: For the next 10 seconds, you will remove and ignore any rooting, snaring, disarming, silencing or disabling effects. Your cast times are reduced by 50%, and you cannot be set back.

coreAbilities.name: Embrace the Warp
coreAbilities.description: You embrace the Warp, surrounding yourself with its power. You will take only 50% damage and your abilities will cost 25% fewer Action Points for 10 seconds. During this time you generate almost no threat, and can not be set back while casting.

coreAbilities.name: Scourged Warping
coreAbilities.description: Warp Reality will now deal 10% more damage per consecutive tick, and every tick of damage has a 20% chance of making the next Scourge or Tzeentch's Cry bypass all of your victim's resistances.

coreAbilities.name: Backlash
coreAbilities.description: Any time you are attacked, there is a 25% chance that you will lash out for 370 Elemental damage over 5 seconds to anyone who hits you.

coreAbilities.name: Divine Protection
coreAbilities.description: Each group member within 100 feet is surrounded by a protective shield for the next 10 seconds that will absorb up to 4500 damage from melee abilities.

coreAbilities.name: Breath of Tzeentch
coreAbilities.description: All opponents within 25 feet of you are knocked back, and monsters are knocked down for 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Sacrificial Renewal
coreAbilities.description: Whenever you critically heal an ally with a direct healing ability, you increase the power of your heals by 15% for 5 seconds, but you also take 10% more damage from all sources.

coreAbilities.name: Warping The Spirit
coreAbilities.description: Each tick of Tzeentch's Cordial has 25% chance to increase target's armor by 594 for 10 seconds. Additionally, 10% less armor will be bypassed when they are attacked.

coreAbilities.name: Tzeentch's Talon
coreAbilities.description: Reduces your target's armor by 1320 and all resistances by 480 for 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Restorative Burst
coreAbilities.description: Any time one of your direct healing effects critically heals an ally, you will regain 40 Action Points over 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Daemonic Fortitude
coreAbilities.description: Increases target's Wounds by 150 for 30 seconds and then heals the recipient for the amount increased.

coreAbilities.name: Blessing of Chaos
coreAbilities.description: Critical heals will Bless your target for 10 seconds, increasing the power of any heals used on them by 25%.

coreAbilities.name: Eye of Sheerian
coreAbilities.description: Increase the armor of all group mates within 100 feet by 1320 and resists by 480 for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Swirling Vortex
coreAbilities.description: Reduce the cooldown of your Mark's granted abilities by 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: By Tzeentch's Will!
coreAbilities.description: Critical direct heals will increase your morale by 75. This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Suppressing The Fragile Unbelievers
coreAbilities.description: You silence disbelievers and inflict 1215 damage over 5 seconds within 25 feet around you.

coreAbilities.name: Drink Deeply
coreAbilities.description: Increase the duration of Tzeentch's Cordial by 6 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Empowered Alteration
coreAbilities.description: Leaping Alteration will deal 25% more healing and will also restore 48 Action Points over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Mark of Remaking
coreAbilities.description:
The groupmember bearing this Mark can resurrect themselves if killed in the next 10 minutes. In addition, the bearer's Toughness is increased by 100 for 1 hour.
You may only give a player one Mark, but players may bear multiple Marks of different types at the same time.

coreAbilities.name: Alter Fate
coreAbilities.description: Restores 1800 health to all group members within 100 feet and increases your outgoing healing by 35% for 10 seconds.
